[[Daggers of Xuekao]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Xuekao, the Deceptive]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Pongmei Valley]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]])
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer
